messages:
Mike: FinOps dashboard flagged a big delta overnight — reserved GPU utilization in us-west2 dropped 82% -> 35% while on-demand spiked. Anyone else seeing this?
Jessica: saw alerts, yes. can we get per-model/per-route breakdown? suspect fallbacks to on-demand model variants.
Rafael: pulled the nightly snapshot. Autoscaler terminated several dedicated pods between 02:12-02:18 UTC. Logs show `ScaleDownPolicy: aggressive` and `min_replicas: 0` in the dedicated-gpu pool.
Jessica: omg, that explains it.
Sasha: also noticed tag mismatch: many dedicated instances are tagged `env:prod` but routes are matched using `service:inference` so allocation mapping failed for some routes.
Mike: can someone paste the query for per-route cost so finance can apportion?
Rafael: sure — running the query now:
```
SELECT model, route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM finops.billing_daily
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-16' AND region='us-west2'
GROUP BY model, route
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Finops-bot: Nightly FinOps snapshot: reserved_utilization_us-west2=35% on-demand_spend_change=+42% commit_coverage=78% (threshold=85%)
Finance-Ana: taking this on, will post per-route numbers in 15m.
Mike: If coverage is < threshold we should consider a short-term hedge (1 month reserved) to avoid higher on-demand delta. Rough approval up to $20k if numbers justify.
Leo: I'm on it — we pushed an autoscaler tweak yesterday for batch jobs; I'll revert aggressive scale-down for the dedicated-gpu pool and set `min_replicas: 1` for critical shards for 03:00-06:00 UTC.
Jessica: thanks. also add an alert for reserved vs on-demand delta >10% over 6h.
Rafael: quick calc: buying 4x reserved V100-equivalent GPUs in us-west2 for 30 days recovers ~65% of the extra on-demand cost. Estimated price ~18k/month. attaching rough calc.
Finance-Ana: posting per-route numbers now:
```
model | route         | cost_usd
gpt-xl | /chat/sync    | 8200
gpt-large | /embeddings  | 4200
gpt-med | /rerank       | 1900
other   | misc routes   | 2700
TOTAL on-demand delta (us-west2 last 24h): ~17,000
```
Finance-Ana: with the 4x reserved hedge we'd cover ~11k of that, net excess ~6k. Recommend approving temporary hedging up to 18k.
Mike: Approved up to 18k pending final invoice. Also add a panel to the dashboard: `reserved_vs_on-demand_delta_24h` and an alert at 10%.
Leo: reverted autoscaler and added probe to avoid zeroing min_replicas. will monitor logs for next two cycles.
Sasha: submitted infra-ticket INFRA-2027 to fix tag mapping (ensure `service:inference` on dedicated nodes).
Finops-bot: Action items summary: 1) autoscaler reverted, 2) infra ticket created, 3) temp reserved purchase pending finance approval, 4) dashboard panel + alert.
Mike: thanks team. monitor 48h, reopen if we see repeat. :thumbsup:
